finding.text: `Server/ServexFence.mjs` and the new `FENCE_SERVEX=1` switch in `Server/Browser.mjs:66` are not indexed in `Server/readme.md` or `Server/doc/browser.md`. `browser.md` is the doc for "the one Chromium launcher", and it now has an env switch it doesn't mention. Add one line to each, linking `Servex/doc/restart.md#when-servex-crashes…`.

Two Dictate scripts still call `route.continue()`, against the new "fallback, never continue" rule (`Servex/doc/restart.md:68`, `core/Test/doc/health.md:38`): `ux/Dictate/test/stall.mjs:53` and `refresh.mjs:138`. Both are for Whisper `:8178/inference`, not Servex, so they are safe today. Still, `ext/Refine/test/composer-flow.mjs:20` continues `**/api/refine**`; check that it never reaches `:8090`.

The shutdown snapshot overwrites a `sustain --restart` snapshot whenever the exit handler runs (`Servex/Servex.js:1587`). The revived agent would then lose its "(asked by X)" note, because `Agents.js:513` drops `by` once `how` is set. That's harmless today, since `sustain.mjs` kills with `taskkill /f` and no handler runs. It's worth a line in restart.md.

`process.on("unhandledRejection")` (`Servex/Servex.js:1603`) changes Node's default from "crash" to "log and continue" for all of Servex. That's a reasonable call and it's documented. Watch `servex.jsonl` for `unhandled_rejection` events piling up silently.

The new tests (`crash-revive.test.mjs`, `voice-page-refused.test.mjs`, `ServexFence.test.mjs`) run by hand only, like `revive-sweep.test.mjs`. No gate runs them. I ran all three in the worktree: 9, 3 and 7 checks passed.
